arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gas smell as serious, even if it's only occasional. Please don't use the oven, hob, light switches or any flame or electrical item near it. Open windows and doors, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger, call 999. We are arranging for a gas engineer to attend as an emergency, with a target of within 24 hours, and will update you once we have a visit confirmed. We are also letting the landlord know. We'll be in touch again today.
